answer: Synchronous pulse ceremony: at an unpredictable moment each epoch, every identity must join a live, unscripted session and answer fresh prompts within seconds, proving one operator is present at that instant. A relic credential or old transcript cannot be replayed, because prompts are bound to that session's entropy. Reaching the zenith of standing requires attending repeatedly, not once. A Sybil farmer cannot be in ten places at once: each puppet needs its own live operator at the exact same second, so bulk forgery becomes bulk simultaneous staffing, and missed sessions demote the identity.
